goal: Determinar cómo se regula la ocupación de C/EBPα sobre el promotor de FTO y si el estrés oxidativo modula esa ocupación en algún tipo celular relevante.

questions.question: According to these sources, is C/EBPα directly reported to bind the FTO promoter, and in which cell types or tissues was that binding demonstrated?
What molecular mechanisms regulate C/EBPα occupancy at the FTO promoter, including chromatin accessibility, co-factors, DNA methylation, or histone acetylation?
Is there evidence that oxidative stress changes C/EBPα occupancy, activity, or promoter binding at FTO or analogous loci in any cell type?
Is any C/EBPα-to-FTO regulatory mechanism shown directly in granulosa or ovarian cells, or is the evidence only indirect or from other tissues?

What is the best-supported model linking C/EBPα regulation to FTO transcriptional control, and how strong is the evidence for extrapolating that model to oxidative-stress-induced FTO loss in granulosa?
What key experimental gaps remain before concluding that oxidative stress modulates C/EBPα occupancy at the FTO promoter in granulosa cells?
